selection: Purposive stratified sample of 18 non-pilot records plus all seven unresolved records; includes mono/polyatomic construction, charge reduction/brackets/formal compound caveat, simple/complex named translation, supplied skeletons, combined/physical-change states, mixed marks, excluded product/ionic tasks, 2019–2025, all empirical bands and separate teaching bands. Accepted pilot dispositions carried forward unchanged.

entries.rationale: AlCl3 (Al3+ with three Cl− ions), ZnSO4 (2:−2 1:1), (NH4)3N (three +1 ions balance −3) are formula construction. Keep source warning that ammonium nitride is a formal charge exercise, not a stable classroom salt.
Two outer electrons establish a Group 2 cation; two F− give neutral ZF2. Placeholder Z and historical reversed-order allowances stay unchanged.
NaCl and ZnO both reduce to 1:1; (NH4)2SO4 requires 2:1 and brackets around repeated ammonium. All three cells remain one three-mark record.
(NH4)2S, Mg(NO3)2 and Al2(CO3)3 use respective 2:1, 1:2 and 2:3 lowest ratios; all requested polyatomic grouping stays correct.
Extracted prose explicitly gives magnesium chloride and hydrogen. Mg+2HCl→MgCl2+H2 conserves atoms; product names, not unspecified reaction prediction, determine the task.

Only the oxygen coefficient is missing; incomplete-combustion products are fixed. C4H9OH+5O2→2CO2+2CO+5H2O balances C4 H10 O11. Source pattern mislabels complete combustion; keep that source ID and use actual extracted operation.
Named NO2/H2O/O2/HNO3 are established. 4NO2+2H2O+O2→4HNO3 balances N4 H4 O12. Keep source formula-dependent balancing mark and empirical band.
All species and their states are named. 2Mg(s)+O2(g)→2MgO(s) balances Mg2 O2 and gives the required solid/gas/solid states, retaining the two-mark whole record.
All product formulae are supplied; only coefficients matter. 2Ca(NO3)2→2CaO+4NO2+O2 balances Ca2 N4 O12, without new product-prediction credit.
All five formulae are supplied. Coefficients 2:4:1:2:2 conserve C4 H12 Cl4 O2; this is balancing, with alkenes retained as meaningful subject context.
Formula equation is supplied; only four states are assessed. Keep source Zn/HNO3/H2 historical premise and explicit oxidising-acid caveat verbatim, without endorsing it as a new reaction model.
Water evaporation l→g, iodine sublimation s→g and ice melting s→l are independent state-symbol rows. Retain source acceptance of words as alternatives; new gem maps the assessed state notation.
y=396/44=9 and z=180/18=10 are two calculation steps; oxygen balancing gives x=14. Keep primary 7.5 and all three marks once, add 16.2 only for the explicit third operation.

Potassium chloride and water are requested as product identities from acid/alkali chemistry; neither named-product-to-symbol translation nor coefficient/state response is assessed. Keep 8.3.
Ba2+(aq)+SO4²−(aq)→BaSO4(s) is an ionic precipitation equation, explicitly outside the new whole-equation scope. Keep 8.5 and both formula/state marks, including historical ECF.
